answer: Parallel attestation cost ledger. Each agent identity must submit a quartz-timestamped coordination receipt signed by two disjoint peer groups; the ledger charges per pairwise attestation, so N sybils require N² receipts. Idle clusters pay a prism fee reflecting their coordination footprint, while honest sparse agents settle cheaply. Attacker cost scales quadratically in identities, making a meadow of fake agents prohibitively expensive to sustain.
